about_short_description.short_description: Nitrode is an AI-assisted gaming platform designed to transform the gaming experience.

product.name: Nitrode Game Engine
product.description: A game development engine built on Godot 4.0 that integrates AI assistance and node-based visual programming for creating games.

product.name: AI-Powered Assistance
product.description: Real-time AI support that helps developers refine game logic, fix bugs, and generate code based on game context.

product.name: Visual Logic Editor
product.description: A node-based visual programming tool that enables users to design game mechanics by connecting nodes without writing boilerplate code.

product.name: Instant Asset Creation
product.description: An AI-driven feature that generates sprites, 3D textures, and scenes directly within the engine, removing the need for external asset tools.
